note: PREREQUISITE: an ADULT save, after the wasp boss. Gameflow stage 200 hands this one directly (GiveHeroQuestCardDirectly 'OBJECT_QUEST_CARD_GUARDIAN_SISTER_INFO_FIRST') and stage 300 waits on its completion before the Orchard Farm cards
Main sets the card objective (TEXT_QUEST_GUARDIAN_SISTER_INFO_FIRST_OBJECTIVE_01, region BowerstoneSlums) and then waits for that region to load

the region BowerstoneSlums is owned by map BowerstoneSlums_v2 = slot 339 (forge world --regions: origin 3744,4224, 256x160), z 29.25 at map-local 64,64. Main's wait is IsRegionLoaded('BowerstoneSlums'), and once it is true the quest sets time of day 10.0
the region being loaded is the whole of Main: SetTimeOfDay(10.0) then return. Everything else is the MazeAtTavern entity

do: QS_GuardianSisterInfo: local h = quest:GetHero(); local g = quest:GetThingWithScriptName('MazeAtTavern'); if g ~= nil then local p = g:GetPos(); p.x = p.x + 1.2; quest:EntityTeleportToPosition(h, p, 0.0, false, false); quest:EntitySetFacingAngleTowardsThing(h, g) end
note: Maze calls the hero over at the tavern; stand BESIDE him and face him (GOTCHAS: a hero teleported into an NPC leaves him unhighlighted). GuardianSpokeToHero is the quest's only persisted state
Gameflow stage 300 waits on MsgOnQuestCompleted('QS_GuardianSisterInfo') and only then adds OBJECT_QUEST_CARD_PROTECT_FARM -- this is the gate in front of Orchard Farm
